articles.title: Alcoa Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
articles.summary: PITTSBURGH, September 15, 2026--Alcoa Corporation (NYSE: AA; ASX: AAI) plans to announce its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, October 15, 2026, after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange. Alcoa will host a conference call to discuss the third quarter 2026 financial results on October 15, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. EDT (October 16, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. AEDT). The call will be webcast live via Alcoa's website, www.alcoa.com.
